title: Renewal Missing-Information Notices — Base Days from the Application Period
content:
## Base days of a renewal's notice

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the response days of a renewal's missing-information notice start from base days set by the application period of the patient's latest first statement. The base days take the place of the tier's missing-information response days (30 calendar days) as the starting figure of the notice's response days; days added to the response days are added on top of the base days.

**Latest first statement.** The latest first post-discharge summary statement (statement cycle 1) issued on any of the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts; its age is counted in calendar days from its statement date to the notice date.

| Age of the latest first statement | Base days |
|---|---|
| no older than the notification period (120 days) | the days left of its application period (240 days less its age) plus the missing-information response days (30), the standard window running on after that period |
| older than 120 days and no older than the application period (240 days) | the larger of the missing-information response days (30) and the days left of its application period (240 less its age) |
| older than 240 days, or no first statement issued | the missing-information response days (30) |

## Worked cases (hypothetical ages)

| Age | Base days |
|---|---|
| 100 | 140 plus 30: 170 |
| 120 | 120 plus 30: 150 |
| 121 | the larger of 30 and 119: 119 |
| 225 | the larger of 30 and 15: 30 |
| 241 | 30 |
